title: Many runs at once, scaled by the queue, and what an operator can see
purpose: Start 24 runs together on workers that can each do six things at once, so the work is more than two workers can hold. Let the autoscaler add workers because the engine's task queue has a backlog, and read the platform's own metrics, ledger and costs while it happens.

steps.display: Prometheus: temporal_activity_task_received and temporal_activity_execution_failed, the workers running now

checks.description: each worker has six activity slots, so two workers hold twelve steps at once
checks.because: Slots are set small so that a modest number of runs exceeds them. What matters is the ratio of runs to slots, not the absolute numbers.
The session API only writes a row and starts a workflow, so starting many at once is cheap.

checks.description: the workers were saturated: every slot was in use at some point
checks.because: Peak slots in use: 24 of 12 available with two workers.

checks.description: the autoscaler added workers because of the queue's backlog
checks.because: Peak workers: 4. The trigger is the engine's task queue, not CPU: a worker waiting for a model or a tool uses almost none.

checks.description: all 24 runs reached the review step
checks.because: Each run is independent: its own history, its own ledger rows, its own sandbox.

checks.description: 24 branches and 24 pull requests exist, one for each run
checks.because: Queueing and scaling did not repeat or lose any step.

checks.description: after the reviews, all 24 runs completed
checks.because: Approvals reached the waiting workflows, now on whichever workers were running.

checks.description: the gateway's record accounts for every run's tokens, and the model was called 11 times per run
checks.because: Cost per run is a query over one table, because every call goes through the gateway.

checks.description: the backlog is visible in the engine's own records: a few steps waited for a slot, most did not
checks.because: Steps that queued behind a full set of workers waited until a slot opened or the autoscaler's new workers joined. The median step started at once.

checks.description: the workers' own metrics are being collected
checks.because: Each worker serves Prometheus metrics, and Prometheus finds the pods by their annotations.
